title: Attention mechanisms, explained
summary: This offline demo explains how attention weighs relevant context and why multiple heads learn complementary relationships. Every graph edge and answer citation can be traced to its transcript evidence.

transcript.text: Attention lets a model weigh the tokens that are most relevant to the current prediction.
The query compares with keys, and the resulting weights select information from values.
Multi-head attention repeats this process in parallel so different heads can focus on different relationships.
The head outputs are combined, giving the next layer several views of the same context.
A grounded answer should link back to the exact timestamp and quote that support it.
